title: Cohort Latency Compass: route-level p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs sync decomposition
creator: Priya Nair
description: Deliver a set of route/model latency dashboards that surface p50/p95/p99 for cohorts defined by request shape and IO mode (streaming vs sync). Dashboards must support quick comparison across model variants, show recent regressions, and provide links into trace samples and logs for fast RCA.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard tile for each route showing p50/p95/p99 over time with selectable cohort filters (streaming, sync, combined)
Cohort selector to group by request-shape buckets (short/medium/long tokens), model version, and customer tier
Drill-down: clicking a percentile opens a trace-sample modal pre-filtered and linked to tracing UI and the corresponding logs
Percentile calculation uses the same histogram-driven method as SLO backend to avoid metric drift
Low-cardinality labels only; avoid per-customer label explosion (use 'customer_tier' instead)
Automated alert rule examples for 5% relative increase in p95 over 6h for any route-cohort
